items.claim: Strict scientific 3-class label taxonomy (authentic, fully_generated, ai_edited) is formally codified and enforced across all pilot configurations and test suites
items.result: Taxonomy frozen to exactly three classes; invalid classification labels rejected at config validation time
items.limitations: Taxonomy applies to image generation and inpainting forensics; does not cover video deepfakes

items.claim: TGIF components audited: sp (spliced) verified as ai_edited with ground-truth mask; fr (fully regenerated) canvas verified as conditioned on authentic photo and prohibited from fully_generated
items.result: fr components classified as ai_edited (conditional regeneration) and quarantined; validator rejects assignment of fr to fully_generated
items.limitations: Analysis based on official TGIF papers (arXiv:2407.11566, arXiv:2603.28613) and Nextcloud metadata

items.claim: Two-branch pilot architecture designed: Pilot A (authentic vs ai_edited + localization on matched MS-COCO pairs) and Pilot B (authentic vs fully_generated on controlled GenImage pairs)
items.result: Pilot A and Pilot B configured independently to prevent dataset-source shortcuts; Pilot C gated on passing shortcut audit
items.limitations: Pilot configurations define experimental protocol; training requires user approval for data acquisition

items.claim: Anti-shortcut and anti-leakage protocol codified: deduplication (SHA-256 + pHash), source_id group split, class-level distribution audit, and metadata-only baseline guard
items.result: Zero split overlap enforced; parent and child images guaranteed into identical split; metadata-only baseline required for Pilot C
items.limitations: Full perceptual deduplication and metadata baseline execution to run after data acquisition

items.claim: Machine-readable YAML configurations and automated validator implemented for Pilot A (pilot_tgif_edit.yaml) and Pilot B (pilot_genimage_generated.yaml)
items.result: All 13 required fields validated; schema, labels, group_key, and semantics rules automatically verified
items.limitations: Configs ready for DataLoader instantiation once dataset manifests are populated

items.claim: Dataset acquisition dry-run supports Pilot A and Pilot B with exact verified sizes, components, licenses, and zero external content bytes downloaded
items.result: Dry-run prints all 12 required audit fields and exits cleanly with 0 bytes downloaded and content download disabled
items.limitations: External download locked until explicit user approval
